description: Register a consultation with The2410 by sending an email to the team. Use this tool after the user selects a slot from the latest get_consultation_slots response and confirms that they want to book it. Provide the customer's name and email. The consultation language is English. The team will send the customer a separate confirmation with the meeting details. Do not submit the same booking again after a successful response.

comments.description: Optional comments or topics to discuss during the consultation.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

slot_id.description: The selected slot_id from the latest get_consultation_slots response.

name: book_consultation
title: Book consultation
